lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration, with distinct vertical alignments of spots across the mid-section of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect precisely at the high-luminance blobs, forming a network of grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the visible flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed gradient on the ventral side.
